concordance-990pf.csv: the 990-PF database

Source: vignettes/articles/concordance-990pf-csv.Rmd
concordance-990pf-csv.Rmd

The concordance of the 990-PF research database: the Form 990-PF xpaths, the return header shared with the 990 and Schedule B, with the 990-PF mappings of shared xpaths, in the v1 column layout. This page is built from the package with concordance("v1", form = "F990PF"), the same call that writes concordance-990pf.csv at the root of the repository, so the table and the download always match the package. The full concordance is concordance.csv.

The variables are described in the 990-PF data dictionary. R users can skip the file: concordance990::concordance(form = "F990PF") returns the same table.

Using the table. Search matches any of the 24 columns, and the chips filter by form. Click a label to see the other columns of that xpath. Click a variable name to open its validation page. Download matching rows saves only the rows that match the search and filter.
